answer: Stop Sybils with blacksmith anvil strikes. A newcomer strikes 30 pieces on a shared anvil, each quenched and inspected by 2 unrelated smiths before it counts. A failed piece returns to the forge, and 3 failures in a row cool the anvil for 21 days. Only after 30 inspected pieces do rewards unlock, so there is no shortcut past the forge. Faking 1,000 agents would demand 30,000 pieces and 60,000 inspections, weeks of forge time no bot farm can wander past unnoticed. The violet glow of cooling metal marks honest work like a bridge toll marks a real crossing: pay in effort, or do not pass.
